name: Pond's Face Wash Pure Detox Pollution Clear with Activated Carbon 100ml | Bangladesh
description:
Pond's Face Wash Pure Detox Pollution Clear with Activated Carbon – 100g 

Made for Bangladesh Market

Key Features:

Activated Charcoal Technology – Draws out dirt, oil, and pollution particles from deep within pores.

Deep Cleansing Formula – Removes impurities, excess oil, and dead skin cells without over-drying.

Pollution & Dirt Removal – Effectively clears away pollutants for a refreshed, detoxified complexion.

Gentle Yet Effective – Suitable for daily use; keeps skin smooth, clean, and glowing.

Suitable for All Skin Types – Works especially well for oily skin, leaving a natural matte finish.

Natural Glow – Promotes brighter, radiant-looking skin by uncovering your natural clarity.

Benefits:

✅ Cleanses deeply & unclogs pores
✅ Reduces blemishes and uneven skin tone
✅ Removes excess oil while maintaining skin balance
✅ Fresh, pollution-free glow after every wash
